sources.phone: Android DeviceMotionEvent exposed by Even app WebView

phoneUnits: browser API: acceleration in m/s² when supplied; verify device/WebView implementation
phoneAxes: DeviceMotionEvent device-relative x/y/z; orientation may differ from G2
timestamp: Both t fields are monotonic milliseconds at WebView event receipt on one clock; wallTime is ISO UTC. They are receipt times, not sensor acquisition times.
